Recent advances in artificial intelligence, computer science, data science, 
software engineering, cybersecurity, and computational systems are reshaping 
nearly every aspect of modern society. In response to this rapid and 
transformative progress, the Artificial Intelligence and Computing Target 
Journal (AICTJ) is formally launched as a peer-reviewed academic platform 
dedicated to disseminating high-quality, innovative, and interdisciplinary 
research in these dynamic fields. The journal aspires to serve researchers, 
engineers, practitioners, and scholars by fostering scholarly dialogue and 
promoting impactful scientific contributions. 
AICTJ is committed to advancing both theoretical foundations and 
practical applications of artificial intelligence and computing technologies. 
Through the collective efforts of its editorial board, reviewers, and 
contributing authors, the journal upholds the highest academic, ethical, and 
professional standards. By publishing rigorous, original, and evidence-based 
research, AICTJ aims to support technological innovation while addressing 
complex computational and societal challenges. 
Contemporary 
technological 
problems 
increasingly 
require 
interdisciplinary perspectives and collaborative solutions. AICTJ actively 
promotes cross-disciplinary research by bringing together expertise from areas 
such as machine learning, intelligent systems, human–computer interaction, 
cloud computing, high-performance computing, and emerging computational 
paradigms. By encouraging collaboration between academia and industry, the 
journal seeks to bridge theory and practice and contribute to the development 
of next-generation intelligent systems. 
Global cooperation and open knowledge exchange lie at the heart of 
AICTJ’s mission. As an open-access journal, AICTJ ensures that published 
research is freely and widely accessible to researchers, educators, industry 
professionals, and policymakers around the world. This commitment to 
openness aims to reduce barriers to knowledge, promote inclusivity, and 
support the equitable dissemination of scientific and technological 
advancements. 
Quality, rigor, and integrity form the cornerstone of AICTJ. All 
submissions undergo a comprehensive peer-review process to ensure 
originality, methodological soundness, and scholarly significance. This 
process safeguards the journal’s academic credibility and reinforces trust 
among its readerships. 
We warmly invite researchers, academics, industry experts, and 
practitioners to contribute to the Artificial Intelligence and Computing Target
